scope: 21 current images, including 9 v5 replacements following five client comments.

checks.b1_living_three: pass: identical room shell, kitchen/fridge placement and D dining table in all styles; flat short end against south/right wall, rounded free end toward room, four chairs along sides
checks.b2_living_three: Visually checked: recessed lower hanging row, deeper upper row to ceiling aligned with fridge, microwave immediately left of fridge; same furniture arrangement.
checks.b2_bedroom_three: Visually checked: removed aerials and railings in window view; room furniture retained. Exterior retouch disclosed; originals unchanged.
checks.b1_bedroom_three: Rebuilt from actual photo04: French doors on right with exterior view retained, rear south wardrobe, left east headboard, no added chamfer/sloping wall. Desk remains offscreen per floor plan. Prior v2/v3 bedroom visual approval is withdrawn and superseded.
checks.b1_bathroom_three: Visually checked: curved quadrant shower and thin transparent WC divider in all three styles. Exact 800 mm size belongs to plan, not pixel image. Glass height remains proposed.
checks.b2_bathroom_three: pass photo-supported fixture arrangement: vanity left, tub forward, open room and fixed tiles/fixtures retained
checks.b1_living_art: One artwork on perpendicular bathroom wall beside window, all three styles.
checks.b1_living_reverse: Supplementary entrance-to-window view based on room photo, model and approved palette; visual relationship check only, not metric calibration.

lighting_verticals: Fixtures appear lit in all 21 images and dominant wall/door/cabinet verticals read straight. This is visual inspection, not lens calibration.
surface_consistency: Within each room the floor and wall structure/texture are visually stable across the three styles; furniture textiles, wood cabinetry, art and lamps vary by palette as intended.
limits: Perspective images cannot establish exact millimetre dimensions or prove every hidden furniture clearance. Geometry conclusion is visual and plan-based, not a measured survey. The old bedroom images and their prior pass are superseded because they did not support faithful same-view comparison.
resolution_note: The three approved photo-based bathroom 2 images retain cropped source pixel dimensions: 1300x954, 1300x954 and 1366x1004. No minimum resolution was agreed. The gallery uses object-fit:contain; preserve these source-based outputs without upscaling or regeneration. The other 18 images are 1448x1086.
